proposal.reason: Main change is in review-routing behavior: `.github/workflows/review-routing.yml` updates the reusable-workflow input `pr_number` to `fromJSON(format(...))`, fixing numeric-type normalization at the reviewer-invitation call boundary after classification. This is owned by `workflow` because it changes review-routing/assignment automation wiring and input contract handling, not CI test execution (`ci`) or build/runtime modules.
